# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 21 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 21
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It is a good thing to learn the Lord's righteous judgments, as many as are written, and to live by them. Whoever does this will be honored in God's kingdom. Whoever chooses the other way will go under along with their deeds.
2. That is why there is a resurrection. That is why there will be a day of repayment. I urge those of you in positions of honor: if any of my counsel is worth anything to you, keep close to the people who are genuinely helping you — do not let this slip.
3. The day is coming soon when everything will collapse together with the evil one. The Lord is near — and his reward comes with him.
4. I urge you again and again: be good guides for each other, be honest advisors to each other, strip all hypocrisy out from among you.
5. May God — the Lord of the whole world — give you wisdom, understanding, discernment, and knowledge of his righteous requirements, and may he give you patience.
6. Learn from God. Search out what the Lord asks of you, and do it — so that when judgment day comes, you will be found worthy.
7. And if anything good is remembered about me, remember me as you think about these things — so that my longing for you and my watching over you will have counted for something.
8. I ask one thing of you as a gift: be faithful to each other.
